Breaking Down the Ending of The Remarried Empress

It’s hard to imagine The Remarried Empress appearing on a streamer other than Disney+. The K-drama plays out like a fairy tale. Adapted from a massively successful webcomic and webtoon of the same name, the series stars Hometown Cha Cha Cha ’s Shin Min-a as the empress of a fictional Eastern Empire.
